versions.changelog: SkillSpector v2.1.0: declared permissions; narrow triggers; persistent-storage warnings; --i-consent on writes; require LYRA_CORE_ROOT (no silent path scan)

LYRA 3-Brain v2.0.0 — Major upgrade introducing a powerful, reference-driven memory system for agent workflows.

- Implements 3-part memory: working (RAM/session turn), library (sealed/grown nodes), and outer (URLs/pointers/IDs).
- Adds detailed session logging, daily snips, secure/consent-gated archive, and graph-based recall.
- Integrates with LYRA_CORE, P0/Oath, seals, OpenClaw, Moltx, and lynks to external systems via references.
- Provides CLI tools and rituals for session close, memory growth, and recall.
- Enforces agent-safe memory: no secrets, explicit user consent for publish/overwrite, and rules for lattice alignment logging.
- Thorough documentation and workflow examples included in SKILL.md.
